items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: But Edmund, Robert, and Clowns, all of them we played together, we come up together you see, we played together you see.

ctx.x: He never played with us because he left and went away, he went to Texas you see. He left and went to Texas. But Edmund, Robert, and Clowns, all of them we played together, we come up together you see, we played together you see. So well after that all left, well quite naturally that just left me. So now. I said well, I said it's my move now you know. So what I did Mr. Bill, I met up my mind and left. That's why I came here. I was down here living on Clio Street when this boy River, Elton, when he written on the…

items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: My very first job, I think it was with Thomas Band

ctx.x: I see. And your first, your very first job was with who?
My very first job, I think it was with Thomas Band, it's been so long ago, I think it was Thomas, just a bunch of kids, we picked up our instruments after playing.
Do you remember the names of the other fellows at all?

items.title: Betty Lee Hanson, Joe James, George Lewis, Joe Lewis, Joe Butler, Kid Thomas Valentine, Bill Russell, Allan…
items.q: me, Edmund Hall, Robert Hall, we all organized a little band

ctx.x: How did you get a job with it?

Oh, we used to get a lot of work. People, them days, them days wasn't like people today, you know? Anything you do, if you take a tin pan and hit on that dance, you see? But them days, you know what I mean, that's how it was, you see? So, well, we, after that, when we began, me, Edmund Hall, Robert Hall, we all organized a little band, you see? We got a band together, then we began to play, you know, out in the country where I'm from, reserve, you see? So we played for this fella, putting here three or four…
And you did name it that then?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Oh yeah, well, Edmund, Edmund Hall, Robert, Robert Hall, he was the first one to stay with us.

ctx.x: Tell him who was in the band, he'd like to know.
Oh yeah, well, Edmund, Edmund Hall, Robert, Robert Hall, he was the first one to stay with us.
